description: This file declares functions, types, and constants for managing Git packfiles within the libgit2 library, including pack creation, insertion of objects, writing packfiles, and progress callbacks.

methods.name: git_packbuilder_new
methods.description: Initializes a new packbuilder object for a given repository.

methods.name: git_packbuilder_set_threads
methods.description: Sets the number of threads to use for packbuilding, defaulting to autodetect if 0.

methods.name: git_packbuilder_insert
methods.description: Inserts a single object (commit, tree, or blob) into the packbuilder.

methods.name: git_packbuilder_insert_tree
methods.description: Inserts a root tree object and all referenced objects.

methods.name: git_packbuilder_insert_commit
methods.description: Inserts a commit object and its referenced tree.

methods.name: git_packbuilder_insert_walk
methods.description: Inserts objects as given by a revwalk.

methods.name: git_packbuilder_insert_recur
methods.description: Recursively inserts an object and all objects it references.

methods.name: git_packbuilder_write_buf
methods.description: Writes the packfile contents to an in-memory buffer.

methods.name: git_packbuilder_write
methods.description: Writes the packfile and index to a specified path.

methods.name: git_packbuilder_hash
methods.description: Returns the hash of the packfile after writing.

methods.name: git_packbuilder_foreach
methods.description: Creates the pack and passes each object to a callback.

methods.name: git_packbuilder_object_count
methods.description: Returns the total number of objects to be written.

methods.name: git_packbuilder_written
methods.description: Returns the number of objects already written.

methods.name: git_packbuilder_free
methods.description: Frees the packbuilder and associated data.
